exclusion_audit.preview_policy: All v1 package sources excluded, conservatively covering every original human-subset preview item. Explicit additional exposures expand quarantine before sampling.
exclusion_audit.study_link_limit: Exact DOI/abstract and any explicit study_ids/trial_registration_ids only; no guarantee of detecting shared cohorts from abstracts.

heldout_policy: H identities are fixed here; its source/inventories/judgments must not be opened by selectors before a unique S winner is locked. No H-based reselection.
